name: Paladin Oath of Wisdom (Paladin Oath)
body:
Magic can be a powerful force for evil, but an even more powerful force for good. Most paladins have prejudices towards witches, but there are some who have been saved or helped by a good witch, or either have been raised within a good coven, or have a witch in their family. They have recognized that witchcraft can be a gift from good deities, and have sworn to protect and help good practitioners of the Craft against the ones who wouldn’t understand them– other paladins included.

Holy Hex: A paladin with this oath can select a witch hex in place of a mercy. Her effective witch level for these hexes is equal to her paladin level. She cannot select any hex more than once, unless specifically stated. Using a hex consumes one use of the paladin’s lay on hands ability, without further effects. The paladin cannot select hexes of a chaotic or evil nature.

Divine Bond: An oath of wisdom paladin whose bond is with her weapon cannot grant the weapon the flaming, flaming burst, keen, and speed properties. She can instead grant it these additional properties: dispelling, dispelling burst, nullifying, and spell storing. If the paladin’s bond is with her mount, the mount gains the fey animal template instead of the celestial template at 11th level.

Code of Conduct

Respect all sources of good magic.
Defend and assist good witches and other spellcasters.
Don’t have prejudices and keep an open mind.

Oath Spells: The paladin must choose a witch patron at 4th level. This patron’s 1st–4th level spells are treated as her oath spells. The paladin can’t choose any inherently chaotic or evil patrons, like deception, insanity, occult, plague, or trickery.
